verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Custom-coded email templates" as its own feature, so developers can author template HTML. Nothing in the pack shows API-managed template endpoints, merge-tag or variable substitution, MJML support, or a workflow for keeping templates under version control. The Marketing and Transactional APIs are documented only for contacts, campaign sending, SMS, IPs and routes. Missing for 10: API template CRUD, documented variable substitution, MJML support, version-control or code-sync workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
